answer_2.quote: Whisper ASR achieves the word error rates of 0.1625, 0.1121 and 0.1165 for SLURP, Tacotron and Fastspeech samples, respectively.

answer_4.quote: The backtranscribed prompts were presented to the annotator along with the original prompts and the recording of the TTS output. The goal of the annotator was to choose which of the two transcripts was closer to the content of the recording.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators choose which transcript (original or back-transcribed) is closer to the TTS audio content.
